g.text: Orange/green: 250 m shared-arc candidate · Blue: repaired master · Grey: Natural Earth 5.1.1 modern reference
Modern reference compares cartographic detail only; it does not verify historical territorial ownership.
Valid components retained: DEU 22 · AH 24 · Serbia 1. Shared paths are continuous with zero polygon overlap.
Historical status stays provisional; modern coastline proxies and Serbia–Montenegro detailed-overlay limits remain explicit.
